title: Dianome session report v3
description: One split/local/server generation session posted by run() to POST /v1/telemetry/load (the Worker accepts schemas 1-3; schema 3 goes to the dianome_sessions dataset). Every field is required. It never carries prompt or output content. The Worker adds country, colo and an hour-rounded timestamp; it never stores the IP address or user agent string.

mode.description: local: N = L and lm_head + sampling on the client; split: 1 <= N <= L with the server finishing; server: N = 0

N.description: Blocks run on the client (the split point)

client_ms.description: Sum of runtime prefill/decode/export/lm_head/sampling ms over the session

server_busy_ms.description: Sum of the server's busy_ms over the session (0 in local mode)

rtt_ms.description: WebSocket ping median measured before the session (0 in local mode)

tok_per_s.description: new_tokens / decode wall seconds (steps after the first)
